actions.label: Improve
actions.prompt: Rewrite the selected text to be clearer, tighter, and more natural while preserving its meaning.

actions.label: Defuse
actions.prompt: Rewrite the selected text in a calmer, more constructive tone while preserving the point.

actions.label: Summarize
actions.prompt: Summarize the selected text in a concise, useful form.

actions.label: Translate
actions.prompt: Translate the selected text. Use the user instruction as the target language when present.

actions.label: Reply
actions.prompt: Draft a concise reply to the selected text. Use the user instruction as the desired message or stance.

actions.label: Post
actions.prompt: Turn the selected text into a short post in a direct, human voice.

actions.label: AI Detect
actions.prompt: Assess whether the selected text sounds AI-written. Give a short score and the strongest tells.

actions.label: Perspectives
actions.prompt: Stress-test the selected text or decision from 3 to 5 distinct perspectives, then synthesize the result.

actions.label: Custom
actions.prompt: Apply the user instruction to the selected text.
